verdict.rationale: Algolia's docs explicitly cover custom ranking to incorporate business signals beyond textual match, plus Rules for merchandising/promotions, Merchandising Studio for pinning/boosting, and Personalization for user-level ranking affinity — directly matching the story's ask for popularity/recency/margin-style signals. Community evidence corroborates real-world use of custom ranking/analytics tying queries to business outcomes, though one HN comment notes relevance can still degrade for certain queries. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of custom ranking with recency/margin attributes (as opposed to general relevance complaints), and no concrete worked example of margin-based ranking in the evidence.
